name: A Growing Threat
description: The Village Leader, Kaelen, is looking for a capable adventurer to deal with a bandit leader named Rook, who has been harassing the merchants.

1.name: Speak to Magistrate Kaelen
1.description: Find Magistrate Kaelen, who is usually near the village hall, and offer your services.

2.name: Defeat Rook the Bandit
2.description: Kaelen has marked the location of the bandit, Rook, on my map. I need to deal with him and bring back proof of his defeat.
